name: Spec-Driven Development (SDD)
problem: Unclear requirements lead to premature coding, scope creep, and architectural drift.
context: Autonomous engineering agents operating on non-trivial web applications
mechanism: Enforce formal SPEC-0001 documents with Given-When-Then acceptance criteria before any code writing is authorized.
benefits: Clear acceptance criteria for automated QA
tradeoffs: Requires initial upfront specification investment prior to coding
adoption_conditions: Project must be registered in registry.json with approved INTAKE
evidence: EVD-0001 through EVD-0009 demonstrate zero spec ambiguity during remediation phase
